en.headline: Ride-hailing platform licence applications open until 30 October
en.dek: The Transport Department is inviting platform companies to apply for licences, while the transport minister said approvals will be decided on merit and not by a set number of operators.
body: The Transport Department on Friday invited platform companies to apply for ride-hailing service licences, with a deadline of noon on 30 October. Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan said on Saturday that the government would select operators on merit and would not forecast how many platforms would qualify.

A government spokesman said platforms, vehicles and drivers providing ride-hailing services must obtain the relevant licences and permits under the new regulatory regime, most of which took effect on 3 August. Applicant companies must be registered in Hong Kong, keep an office and executives in the city, and show they have lawfully operated in a city of at least 7.5 million people and handled a daily average of 100,000 or more ride-hailing orders in two cities.

Financial tests include three years of audited accounts, paid-up capital of at least HK$50 million, bank deposits of at least HK$30 million and a credit line of at least HK$30 million. An approved licence may run for up to five years, with an annual fee of HK$1.2 million. The application fee is HK$16,250.

Chan said the nine licence conditions also cover operating experience, financial strength, data security and a requirement that platforms offer taxi hailing and keep increasing capacity. She said current daily ride-hailing volume in Hong Kong is about 114,000 trips, which is why the government set a 100,000-order daily benchmark close to the market. The department will hold a briefing for interested platforms in mid-September and is building a data system that licensed platforms must connect to.

zh.headline: 網約車平台牌照開放申請 截止10月30日
zh.dek: 運輸署邀請平台公司申請網約車服務牌照，運輸及物流局局長陳美寶表示會擇優而取，暫不預測會批出多少個牌照。
body: 運輸署周五起邀請平台公司申請網約車服務牌照，截止日期為10月30日中午12時。運輸及物流局局長陳美寶周六表示，當局會按條件擇優而取，暫不會預測有多少平台達標。
政府發言人表示，在新的規管制度下，提供網約車服務的平台、車輛及司機均須領取相關牌照或許可證，大部分條文已於8月3日生效。申請公司須在香港註冊，並在本港常設辦事處及行政人員；亦須證明曾在人口750萬或以上的城市合法營運，以及在兩個有網約車服務的城市每日平均處理10萬宗或以上訂單。
財政要求包括最近三年經審計財務報告、公司資本不少於5,000萬港元，以及至少3,000萬港元銀行存款和3,000萬港元信貸額。獲批牌照最長有效五年，每年牌照費120萬港元，申請費為16,250港元。
陳美寶指，九項牌照條件亦涵蓋營運經驗、財政能力、數據安全，以及平台須提供的士網約服務並持續提升運力。她說本港現時每日網約車約11.4萬車次，因此以每日平均10萬宗訂單作為入場門檻，希望貼近市場。運輸署下月中將舉行簡介會，並正構建數據管理平台，要求獲發牌平台對接。
